# Calm Joints

> Calm Joints (Calm Joints Inc.) is a virtual physiotherapy service in Canada. People book registered physiotherapists online. Managed Physio is online physio Scale runs for a partner's customers or employees. They book on the Calm Joints site. Digital care first; in person only if needed. Canada-wide now. USA planned Q1 2027. Partners share the revenue.

## Enterprise: one click to physio
- [Managed Physio. One click to physio.](https://calmjoints.org/enterprise): Scale runs online physio for a partner's customers or employees. They book on the Calm Joints site. Setup is agreed with the partner. Canada-wide now. USA planned Q1 2027. Optional turnkey co-branded store.
- Contact: info@calmjoints.org or the form at https://calmjoints.org/enterprise#talk

## For people
- [Home](https://calmjoints.org/): Book virtual physio with a registered physiotherapist.
- [Talk to a guide](https://calmjoints.org/chat): Virtual recovery guides (not clinicians).
- [Blog](https://calmjoints.org/blog): Recovery articles.

## Partners
- [Partnerships](https://calmjoints.org/partners): Hubs and partnerships for gyms, studios, brands, employers and clinics.
- [Careers](https://calmjoints.org/careers): Roles for physiotherapists.

## Notes
- Calm Joints is not a medical device and not emergency care. In an emergency, call 911.
